title: Node.js 20 Backend Essentials
description: Build fast, scalable server-side JavaScript with Node.js 20. Master ES modules, the event loop, fs/promises, HTTP servers, streams, and REST API patterns.
outcomes: Run JavaScript on the server with Node.js 20 built-in modules (node:fs, node:path, node:http)
Understand the non-blocking event loop and async/await I/O
Read and write files safely with fs/promises and path.join()
Parse environment config and JSON payloads cleanly
Design RESTful HTTP endpoints with proper status codes and error handling
